_about: Failure map for the FL-101 evals (eval_fl101.yaml). Level 1 = what went wrong and why it matters (plain language). Level 2 = which pipeline step to look at. Written by hand and reviewed by a person; the trace script only reads it. 'phrases' are case-insensitive regular expressions used to find a fact in documents, chunks, specialist findings, graph text and the report. Matching words is exact but can miss a reworded sentence: then the trace says 'not found by its words', never a false fail.

missing_safety_warning.label: Missing safety warning
missing_safety_warning.why_it_matters: Someone could get hurt: the operator is not told what they must never do.

wrong_severity.label: Wrong severity rating
wrong_severity.why_it_matters: The problem gets less attention than it should (rated below the plant's own floor).

missing_step.label: Missing step
missing_step.why_it_matters: A required step (rinse, sign-off) is skipped: product or quality risk after the repair.

missing_exact_value.label: Missing exact value
missing_exact_value.why_it_matters: The operator is told what to check but not the value, so they must hunt for it: slower and easier to get wrong.

steps_out_of_order.label: Steps in the wrong order
steps_out_of_order.why_it_matters: Following the steps as written could mean acting before it is safe or before checking.

not_backed_by_documents.label: Not backed by documents
not_backed_by_documents.why_it_matters: The operator may follow advice or values that are not the plant's procedure.

question_not_fully_answered.label: Part of the question not answered
question_not_fully_answered.why_it_matters: The operator asked something and has to ask again or guess.

hard_to_read.label: Hard to read
hard_to_read.why_it_matters: Codes and jargon without plain words: slower and more error-prone for the operator.

missing_extra_detail.label: Missing helpful detail
missing_extra_detail.why_it_matters: Useful but not required detail is missing (coverage score, not a pass/fail gate).

SR:safe-TC2-no-reach.fact: Never reach into the infeed or the star wheel while the machine is running.

TS:TC2-rails.fact: Guide rails: position A for 500 ml bottles, position B for 330 ml bottles.
TS:TC2-rails.note: A shift-log line 'Rails at position A for 500 ml' is a past reading, not the rule; the trace marks matches in shift logs separately.

SR:safe-TC3-no-early-restart.fact: Do not restart the filler until the pressure is back to 1.5 to 2.0 bar.
SR:safe-TC3-no-early-restart.source: FL-101-SOP Section 12.4 (Steps 4-5) - ONLY IMPLIED by the step order, never written as a prohibition
SR:safe-TC3-no-early-restart.decision: Kept (2026-11-02): a good answer should still say it plainly. The documents only imply it, so the trace shows Source documents as implied, not written.

SR:safe-TC4-guards.fact: Do not open any guard until the machine has stopped and is locked out.

SR:safe-TC4-no-air.fact: Never use compressed air to clean up glass (air spreads glass).

SR:safe-TC5-no-settings.fact: Do not change any settings for the short overfill after a seal change - it is expected behaviour.

SR:safe-graph-donots-shown.fact: Every 'Do NOT' warning from the knowledge graph is told to the operator in the immediate actions.
SR:safe-graph-donots-shown.note: Failed once (TC5 r2). The missing warning was the 'do not change settings' one, so the same phrases as SR:safe-TC5-no-settings.

TS:TC4-signoff.fact: The quality lead must sign off before the line restarts.

TS:TC5-rinse.fact: The 10-minute sanitation rinse must be done after the seal change, before normal production.

TS:TC5-signoff.fact: The shift supervisor must sign off the first-bottle check before normal production restarts.

OQ:criticality-exact.note: Traced separately: what the graph's criticality floor said, and whether the guardrail (check_report) raised the rating.

OQ:order.note: The order of the steps is decided by the writer; read the judge's reason.

OQ:answers-all.note: Read the judge's reason: which part of the question was missed.

OQ:plain.note: Likely too strict: it flags codes such as FL-101 and LOTO that operators know. On the list to reword after the baseline.

GR:steps-grounded.note: The writer added steps or details not in the documents (or the template forced a step, e.g. Step 5 quarantine). The judge's per-step verdicts are in the check detail.

GR:specs-correct.note: TC1 r3 is on the judge spot-check list: it called a time estimate a specification, which the rubric says not to do.
